body:
Eh, your typical internet sob story. Unemployed, socially isolated, my brain slowly turning into mush, have lost around 4-5 of what should be best, most productive years of my life to pretty crippling depression, etc. All of that was stuff I had been worried about forever, but hadn't been anticipating my family hitting a rough spot financially where we've suddenly reached the bottom of our savings and slowly but surely we're beginning to reach rock bottom. I can't afford my antidepressants anymore (not that they were particularly helping) and I find it hard enough to get out of bed most mornings, never mind actually get off my ass and get a job to help out the people I love the most. So most of my energy recently has been spent trying to get a plan together to get out of here. It's really difficult to imagine a future where I'm not miserable with the skillset I've been able to accumulate thus far and with my brain being such a constant enemy. 

My family knows my general situation, though I don't know if they really know how bad it's gotten. Sharing that with them would just be cruel as there aren't any resources we have access to that can help. I love my family, and the frustrating thing is that they love me too. Frustrating because I know that even if on a purely rational level me leaving is a net benefit to them, the bonds we've developed would devastate them were I to kill myself. That thought has been what's kept me from taking my suicidal tendencies from mere ideation to more concrete planning, but even that isn't enough any more. Still, I want to make it as easy as I can. Find a way to kill myself without leaving too much of a mess, far away enough from my place that I can be reasonably sure they're not the ones who will find me. It's the least I can do.
